title: FEC Administrative Improvements Act

claims.claim: Makes two changes to the Federal Election Campaign Act of 1971
claims.sourceSpan: To amend the Federal Election Campaign Act of 1971
claims.note: Two substantive amending sections (SEC. 2, SEC. 3) to FECA of 1971; SECTION 1 is short title only.

claims.claim: Section 2 amends 52 U.S.C. 30104(a)(11)(A)(i)
so that the electronic filing requirement covers persons who "make[] electioneering communications," not just those making expenditures
claims.note: Inserted after 'expenditures'; ADDS a covered class (expand, not repeal). SEC. 2 heading 'REQUIRING ELECTRONIC FILING' backs the electronic-filing framing.

claims.claim: Section 3 rewrites 52 U.S.C. 30102(h)(1)
claims.note: 'rewrites' = strike-and-insert amendment.

claims.claim: to let political committees make disbursements by means other than a check drawn on the committee's account
claims.sourceSpan: except by check drawn on such accounts in accordance with this section
claims.section: SEC. 3 — PERMITTING POLITICAL COMMITTEES TO MAKE DISBURSEMENTS BY METHODS OTHER THAN CHECK
claims.note: Direction correct: strikes the check-only requirement. 'the committee's account' is a light gloss of the struck phrase 'such accounts'; full 302(h)(1) statutory text not in fetched source, so the singular is interpretive, not verbatim.

claims.note: 'FEC' = Federal Election Commission, named in source via short title 'FEC Administrative Improvements Act'; the insertion 'or makes electioneering communications' brings such makers under the electronic report-filing clause.

claims.claim: and lets political committees pay by methods other than check
